The request body did not arrive within 30 seconds, or the operation's own x-hive-body.read_timeout_s when it declares one.

x-hive-signing.encoding: Each string is its tag then its fields, one per line, joined by a single line feed (U+000A), encoded as UTF-8; no field may contain a line break.

example.typed: aaaq eaye auda ocaj bifq ydio b4

invite_code.form: Hash the code in its canonical form, as UTF-8: its 26 base32 characters (A-Z, 2-7) upper case, in groups of four joined by '-' (the last group has two). A person may type it in any case, with or without dashes or spaces.

x-hive-signing.nonce: Unpadded base64url over at least 16 random bytes; single use.
x-hive-signing.signature: Unpadded base64url: Ed25519's raw 64 bytes, or a WebCrypto P-256 signature in IEEE P1363 form (r || s, 64 bytes).

hive-request-v1: raw path and query exactly as sent (path?query, or path alone)
request body SHA-256 (hex; of the empty string when there is no body)
hive-ws-v1: raw path and query exactly as requested

x-hive-signing.webhooks: A webhook carries X-Hive-Signature (the Hive's Ed25519 key over hive-webhook-v1), X-Hive-Timestamp and X-Hive-Event-Id (dedupe on it); verify with the key GET /v1/push/hive-key answers, which enrolment also returned.
